title: Ridge Feeder Anomaly
author: Lena Abernathy, Grid Dispatch
pages: 02:14. A bright flash over Beaucatcher, then the whole east side blinked.

The ridge feeder shows reverse flow, as if something up there is pulling current instead of using it. Sent a truck. The crew says the substation is fine. The meters are just spinning the wrong way. Logging it and going back to my coffee.
